archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Gym SaaS & Tactical Fitness)

touch_targets_and_layout.safe_areas: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and env(safe-area-inset-top) handling with pb-safe / pt-safe
touch_targets_and_layout.bottom_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10 px-4 py-2
touch_targets_and_layout.card_padding: p-5 rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/60 shadow-xl backdrop-blur-md

component_guidelines.MButton: Ensure active:scale-95 transition-transform duration-150 min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center font-medium shadow-lg shadow-violet-500/20 rounded-xl
component_guidelines.BottomSheet: Max height 85vh, rounded-t-3xl bg-slate-900 border-t border-white/15 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-2xl p-6 drag-handle on top
component_guidelines.Seg_Pills: Segmented tab control with smooth sliding indicator, 44px min height, high contrast active state
component_guidelines.TextInput: h-12 px-4 bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-700/60 focus:border-violet-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-violet-500/30 rounded-xl text-white transition-all
component_guidelines.StatusChip: Capsule badge with subtle glowing dot (emerald/amber/rose/violet), px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-semibold rounded-full
component_guidelines.ListSkeleton: Staggered pulse skeleton loader with dark slate gradients matching real list row heights
component_guidelines.EmptyRow: Tactile empty state with phosphor/lucide icon in glowing violet ring, clear title, action CTA button
component_guidelines.SectionTitle: Flex row with uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-bold text-violet-400 with trailing subtle divider line

screens_refinement.Onboarding: 4-slide carousel with swipe gestures, dot indicators with elastic active bar, gradient backdrop glow, sticky bottom next/skip actions
screens_refinement.Welcome: Hero gym visual with vignette blur overlay, glass cards, vibrant 'Login' and 'Register' buttons with 48px+ touch targets
screens_refinement.Login_Register: Multi-step form with clear visual progress bar, active field ring focus, show/hide password toggle, clear validation feedback
screens_refinement.Home: Today's Collection gradient hero card with live metric telemetry in JetBrains Mono, quick action pills, 6 Bento metric tiles with subtle borders, recent transactions list
screens_refinement.Attendance: High-contrast QR scanner viewport with glowing corners, tactile manual check-in button, instant attendance toast notification
screens_refinement.Manage: Sticky segmented tabs (Members, Plans, Enquiries, Expenses, Outlets, Staff), search bar with instant filter, swipeable action list rows, bottom-sheet create/edit forms
screens_refinement.Profile: Gym subscription tier card with shiny metallic/violet sheen, dark mode / appearance selector pills, quick gym info rows, change password sheet, and red danger zone sheet for 'Delete my account' requiring confirmation keyword typing 'DELETE'

image_urls.description: Atmospheric gym interior with professional weight machines and modern ambient lighting
Luxury dark gym with weightlifting equipment and neon purple lighting accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Refine spacing across all screens in /app/frontend/src/mobile/ using generous padding (p-4 to p-6) and 44px+ touch targets.
Preserve all data-testid attributes and existing logic/features.
Apply safe-area padding for mobile navigation bars and top headers (pt-safe, pb-safe).
Ensure dark mode contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards with explicit text colors on hover/active states.
Add micro-interactions (active:scale-95, backdrop-blur-xl, subtle borders border-white/10).
